description_en: Invoke QueryTransferInList to query the domain name transfer-in list
description_zh: 调用QueryTransferInList查询域名转入列表
name: QueryTransferInList

parameters.help_en:
The language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user IP address, which can be set to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: The start time for submitting the domain name list for transfer-in
parameters.help_zh: 提交域名列表转入的开始时间
parameters.name: submission_start_date

parameters.help_en: End time for submitting the domain name list for transfer-in.
parameters.help_zh: 提交域名列表转入的结束时间
parameters.name: submission_end_date

parameters.help_en: The domain name, which supports prefix matching (fuzzy query)
parameters.help_zh: 域名，前缀匹配（模糊查询）
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
Transfer status. Valid values:  
INIT: Submit transfer-in.  
AUTHORIZATION: Authorize transfer-in (email verification).  
NAME_VERIFICATION: Name review.  
PASSWORD_VERIFICATION: Transfer password verification.  
PENDING: Transfer-in in progress.  
SUCCESS: Transfer-in succeeded.  
FAIL: Transfer-in failed.
parameters.help_zh:
转移状态。取值：
INIT：提交转入。
AUTHORIZATION：授权转入（邮箱验证）。
NAME_VERIFICATION：命名审核。
PASSWORD_VERIFICATION：转移密码验证。
PENDING：转入处理中。
SUCCESS：转入成功。
FAIL：转入失败
parameters.name: simple_transfer_in_status

parameters.help_en: The page number of the domain name list
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The page size for paging the domain name list
parameters.name: page_size

CurrentPageNum.description_en: The page number of the current domain name list

TransferInInfo.description_en: The list of domain name transfer-in information

Email.description_en: The mailbox to which the domain name transfer-in confirmation email was sent
Email.description_zh: 域名转入确认邮件发送邮箱

ExpirationDate.description_en: The expiration time of the domain name transfer-in

ExpirationDateLong.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the domain name transfer-in expires
ExpirationDateLong.description_zh: 域名转入过期的时间戳

ModificationDate.description_en: The update time of the domain name transfer-in information
ModificationDate.description_zh: 域名转入信息的更新时间

ModificationDateLong.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the domain name transfer-in information was updated
ModificationDateLong.description_zh: 域名转入信息更新的时间戳

NeedMailCheck.description_en:
Indicates whether email verification is required. Valid values:

true: Email verification is required.
false: Email verification is not required
NeedMailCheck.description_zh:
是否需要邮件验证。取值：

true：需要。
false：不需要

ProgressBarType.description_en:
The type of progress bar chart for the domain name transfer procedure. Valid values:  
0: Both email verification and naming review are required.  
1: Email verification is required, but naming review is not required.  
2: Naming review is required, but email verification is not required.  
3: Neither email verification nor naming review is required.
ProgressBarType.description_zh:
域名转移过程进度条类型。取值：
0：同时需要邮箱验证和命名审核。
1：需要邮箱验证不需要命名审核。
2：需要命名审核不需要邮箱验证。
3：不需要邮箱验证不需要命名审核

ResultCode.description_en:
The error code indicating the reason for failure when a domain name transfer fails. Valid values:
clientCancelled: You canceled this domain name transfer-in.
clientRejected: The original registrar denied this domain name transfer-in (or you performed a rejection operation through the original registrar).
serverCancelled: The domain name registry canceled the transfer-in.
transferProhibited: The domain name is in a transfer-prohibited status.
transferExpired: You did not complete the required transfer-in confirmation within the validity period.
nameVerificationFailed: The domain name naming review did not pass.
transferSubmitted: Another user has already submitted a domain name transfer-in request
ResultCode.description_zh:
域名转移失败时的失败原因code。取值：
clientCancelled：您取消了此次域名转入。
clientRejected：域名原注册商拒绝了本次域名转入（或您通过原注册商进行了拒绝操作）。
serverCancelled：注册局取消转入。
transferProhibited：域名为禁止转移状态。
transferExpired：您未在有效期内完成相关转入确认。
nameVerificationFailed：域名命名审核未通过。
transferSubmitted：其他用户已经提交域名转入

ResultDate.description_en: The time when the domain name transfer succeeded or failed
ResultDate.description_zh: 域名转移成功或失败的时间

ResultDateLong.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the domain name transfer succeeded or failed
ResultDateLong.description_zh: 域名转移成功或失败的时间戳

ResultMsg.description_en: The description of the failure reason when the domain name transfer failed
ResultMsg.description_zh: 域名转移失败时的失败原因描述
ResultMsg.example: 您取消了此次域名转入

SimpleTransferInStatus.description_en:
The status of the domain name transfer. Valid values:  
INIT: The transfer-in request has been submitted.  
AUTHORIZATION: Authorization for transfer-in (email verification) is required.  
NAME_VERIFICATION: Naming review is in progress.  
PASSWORD_VERIFICATION: Transfer password verification is in progress.  
PENDING: The transfer-in is being processed.  
SUCCESS: The transfer-in succeeded.  
FAIL: The transfer-in failed.
SimpleTransferInStatus.description_zh:
域名转移状态。取值：
INIT：提交转入。
AUTHORIZATION：授权转入（邮箱验证）。
NAME_VERIFICATION：命名审核。
PASSWORD_VERIFICATION：转移密码验证。
PENDING：转入处理中。
SUCCESS：转入成功。
FAIL：转入失败

Status.description_en:
The detailed domain name transfer-in status. Valid values:
10: Initial status.
11: The email containing the authentication token link has been sent.
19: The token link has been successfully authenticated.
20: The naming review has been submitted.
21: The naming review failed.
29: The naming review succeeded.
31: The transfer password is incorrect.
39: The transfer-in submission succeeded.
50: The customer canceled the transfer-in.
51: The transfer-in failed.
52: The transfer-in expired.
59: The transfer-in succeeded
Status.description_zh:
详细域名转入状态。取值：
10：初始状态。
11：已发送邮件验证token链接。
19：token链接已验证成功。
20：已提交命名审核。
21：命名审核失败。
29：命名审核成功。
31：转移密码错误。
39：转入提交成功。
50：客户取消转入。
51：转入失败。
52：转入过期。
59：转入成功

SubmissionDate.description_en: The time when the domain name transfer request was submitted.
SubmissionDate.description_zh: 域名转移请求的提交时间

SubmissionDateLong.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the domain name transfer request was submitted.
SubmissionDateLong.description_zh: 域名转移请求提交的时间戳

TransferAuthorizationCodeSubmissionDate.description_en: The time when the domain name transfer password was successfully submitted
TransferAuthorizationCodeSubmissionDate.description_zh: 域名转移密码提交成功的时间

TransferAuthorizationCodeSubmissionDateL.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the domain name transfer authorization code was successfully submitted.
TransferAuthorizationCodeSubmissionDateL.description_zh: 域名转移密码提交成功的时间戳

WhoisMailStatus.description_en: Indicates whether the registrant's mailbox was scraped from WHOIS. When the domain name transfer-in is in the authorization phase (email verification) and this field is false, it means the registrant's mailbox was not obtained from WHOIS, and manual processing is required
WhoisMailStatus.description_zh: 是否通过whois抓取到域名持有者邮箱。当域名转入处于授权转入（邮箱验证）并且该字段为false时，表示未通过whois抓取到域名持有者邮箱，需要等待人工处理

NextPage.description_en: Indicates whether a next page exists

PageSize.description_en: The paging size of the domain name list

PrePage.description_en: Indicates whether a previous page exists
